Marsh Lane Allotments

Marsh Lane Allotments has forty-two plots on the old brickworks field, let by the year from the first of March. Members share a tool shed, two water troughs and a compost bay, and keep the paths between plots mown through the summer. New members are offered the next free plot in the order they joined the waiting list, usually within a season. The committee meets on the first Tuesday of each month in the hut by the gate, and anyone with a plot is welcome. Rents are kept low by the work days in spring and autumn, when everyone helps clear brambles and mend the fence.
